description: This file contains unit tests for the adaptive audio decoder component within the starboard media framework, utilizing Google Test framework. It tests decoding of audio streams from DMP files, including handling multiple inputs and verifying output frame counts.

classes.name: AdaptiveAudioDecoderTest
classes.description: A Google Test fixture class for testing adaptive audio decoding, handling multiple input streams, decoding, and output verification.

methods.name: GetAudioInputBuffer
methods.description: Creates an InputBuffer for a specific audio sample index from a VideoDmpReader.

methods.name: SetUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, including creating audio components and initializing the decoder.

methods.name: WriteSingleInput
methods.description: Feeds a single audio buffer from the DMP into the decoder.

methods.name: WriteMultipleInputs
methods.description: Feeds multiple audio buffers into the decoder starting from a specified index.

methods.name: WriteEndOfStream
methods.description: Signals end of stream to the decoder.

methods.name: WaitAndProcessNextEvent
methods.description: Waits for and processes the next decoder event (output, consumed, error).

methods.name: WaitAndProcessUntilAcceptInput
methods.description: Waits until the decoder is ready to accept more input.

methods.name: DrainOutputs
methods.description: Reads and verifies all remaining decoder outputs until end of stream.

methods.name: AssertExpectedAndOutputFramesMatch
methods.description: Checks that the number of output frames matches the expected count based on input duration.

methods.name: OnOutput
methods.description: Callback invoked when decoder produces output.

methods.name: OnError
methods.description: Callback invoked when decoder encounters an error.

methods.name: OnConsumed
methods.description: Callback invoked when input buffer has been consumed.

methods.name: ProcessEvent
methods.description: Processes a decoder event (output, consumed, error).

methods.name: ReadFromDecoder
methods.description: Reads decoded audio from the decoder and updates internal state.

methods.name: GetAdaptiveAudioDecoderTestConfigName
methods.description: Generates a string identifier for test configurations based on input files and decoder type.
